jobs.title: Program Director, High-Burden Diseases
jobs.description:
**About OpenAI Foundation**
===========================


AI is already changing how people work, learn, and access care. It has the potential to unlock extraordinary benefits—faster medical breakthroughs, accelerated scientific discovery, more personalized services in healthcare and education, new tools for creativity and invention, higher productivity and economic growth, improved public services like transportation systems, and so much more.


But building powerful systems to benefit humanity is only a part of the work of our mission. Advanced AI models will also present new challenges that are already surfacing, and we need to be prepared to identify these challenges and develop solutions to address them.


These are the two dimensions of what we’re building the Foundation to do. We aim to enable the use of AI to find solutions to humanity’s hardest problems, transform what people are capable of, and deliver real benefits in people’s lives—while working hard with partners to be ready for new challenges, and to help make society resilient, as AI advances.


This work is just beginning. Over the next year, as we quickly ramp up, the Foundation expects to invest at least $1 billion across life sciences and curing diseases, jobs and economic impact, AI resilience, and community programs. This includes early investments toward our previously announced $25 billion commitment to curing diseases and AI resilience.

**About the role**
==================


The OpenAI Foundation is building out its life sciences program to help accelerate progress on curing diseases and improving human health. The program’s initial focus areas include AI for Alzheimer’s, Public Data for Health, and High\-Burden Diseases.


We are looking for a Program Director, High\-Burden Diseases to help build this work from the ground up. We define High\-Burden Diseases as those that lead to over 500,000 deaths and/or 25 million DALYs annually and also face market failures that result in underinvestment in R\&D. These may include diseases like tuberculosis, newborn mortality, stroke, and Hepatitis B. We invest in the application of AI and data to accelerate and unlock R\&D progress to prevent and treat these diseases in a global context. This is a founding role within the Foundation’s Life Sciences and Curing Diseases program. This is a generalist role and you will work across multiple focus areas, helping shape strategy, source and evaluate opportunities, engage with external organizations, and support the deployment of significant resources over time. This role is designed for someone with the flexibility and judgment to operate across a broad range of scientific, strategic, and grantmaking questions.


Over time, you may continue to operate as a cross\-cutting generalist across the High\-Burden Diseases portfolio, or may grow to focus more on a particular area within the portfolio as it expands.


This role requires someone who is highly flexible, thoughtful, strategic, and action\-oriented—comfortable moving between topics and projects, engaging deeply with external experts and organizations, and translating a broad mission into strong recommendations and concrete action.


This role is based in San Francisco, CA (strongly preferred). We currently use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. Some travel to conferences around the U.S. and sometimes other countries is also required.

**In this role, you will**
==========================

* Work closely with the Head of High\-Burden Diseases and other team members to support strategy, grantmaking execution, and ongoing management across the portfolio
* Help source, evaluate, and recommend grants and other funding opportunities across multiple domains within the High\-Burden Diseases program
* Help research new disease or technology areas and determine where the Foundation should focus and develop investment theses under which we will source and develop grants and funding opportunities
* Engage deeply with the external ecosystem, including researchers, nonprofits, startups, academic centers, funders, and other potential grantee organizations around the world
* Build and maintain relationships with leaders across a wide range of scientific and health\-related fields relevant to the Foundation’s work
* Conduct diligence on organizations, projects, and leaders, including assessing scientific merit, execution capability, and potential for real\-world impact
* Write clear internal recommendations, briefs, and strategy memos to support decision\-making
* Identify gaps in the current ecosystem and develop ideas for how the Foundation can support new efforts, partnerships, or field\-building initiatives
* Support the creation of new initiatives from zero\-to\-one, including helping shape concepts, convene stakeholders, and stand up new efforts where needed
* Over time, potentially take on broader ownership of a growing body of work
* Represent the Foundation in external conversations, helping to build credibility, source opportunities, and strengthen the broader field

**You might thrive in this role if you**
========================================

* Are excited to help build a new program from the ground up
* Are highly flexible and comfortable operating across multiple scientific and technical domains in a fast\-moving environment where priorities may evolve over time
* Can take broad, ambiguous problems and turn them into clear recommendations, strong relationships, and concrete action
* Have strong judgment about people, organizations, and scientific opportunities across different areas of life sciences and health
* Are energized by learning quickly, context\-switching across topics, and developing an independent view
* Have a global mindset and understanding of lower and middle income country (LMIC) contexts and realities

jobs.description:
Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Volta Cafe

**Location:** New York City, NY (Pre\-Opening / Site Selection Phase)

**Position Type:** Full\-time

**Compensation:** $195,000 Base Salary \+ Performance Bonus \+ Opportunity to join the founding team

**About Volta Cafe**

Volta Cafe is redefining the modern beverage experience. We are a high\-energy, novel cafe concept specializing in freshly crafted, custom energy drinks formulated with our proprietary line of functional supplements, alongside ceremonial\-grade matcha and specialty coffee.

Because we are currently in active site selection across NYC, we are bringing on our **Chief Operating Officer (COO)** ahead of launch. This gives our future executive the runway to lay the foundation—shaping the space, perfecting drink recipes, building vendor networks, and establishing operating procedures before our doors open.

This role requires a rare hybrid operator: a visionary flavor pioneer obsessed with beverage experimentation, combined with a sharp business executive who lives in spreadsheets, builds financial systems from scratch, and aggressively drives down COGS. You will own the entire lifecycle of Volta Cafe—from pre\-opening buildout and menu formulation to running the floor on day one and scaling the concept as a key member of our founding team.

**Core Responsibilities**

**1\. Pre\-Opening Strategy, Buildout \& Real Estate Input**

* **Site Selection \& Layout Design:** Partner with leadership and real estate brokers to evaluate potential NYC locations, analyze foot traffic, and collaborate with architects/contractors to design an ergonomic bar workflow optimized for fast\-paced functional drink craft.
* **Licensing \& Compliance:** Lead the pre\-opening regulatory process, securing all necessary NYC DOHMH health permits, Department of Buildings approvals, and local business licenses.
* **Supply Chain Infrastructure:** Build the foundational supply chain from scratch—sourcing high\-grade matcha, specialty coffee beans, sustainable packaging, and setting up commercial production/blending pipelines for our proprietary supplement line.

**2\. Pre\-Launch \& Ongoing Beverage R\&D and Menu Development**

* **Craft Energy \& Supplement Design:** Lead product development for our core line of freshly crafted energy drinks, mastering flavor profiles that blend natural fruit bases, botanicals, and proprietary supplement formulations.
* **Matcha \& Coffee Excellence:** Develop high\-end matcha and specialty coffee programs, creating signature pairings, seasonal drinks, and functional lattes.
* **Constant Flavor Experimentation:** Utilize the pre\-opening ramp period to run rigorous flavor testing, paneling, and menu planning. Post\-launch, maintain an agile R\&D pipeline based on customer sales data.
* **Recipe Costing \& Standardized Formulation:** Convert kitchen experiments into scalable SOPs with exact dosing guidelines, batch prep rules, yield formulas, and strict gross margin targets.

**3\. Financial Setup, Accounting \& COGS Optimization**

* **Ground\-Zero Financial Modeling:** Establish our initial P\&L structure, operating budgets, cash flow management systems, and labor models prior to store launch.
* **COGS \& Expense Auditing:** Negotiate aggressive supplier contracts across supplements, dairy/alt\-milks, coffee, matcha, and packaging to lock in low unit costs and target COGS from day one.
* **Accounting Integration:** Partner with accounting/bookkeeping to set up POS systems (Toast), inventory management software (Restaurant365\), and automated accounts payable workflow.
* **Menu Engineering \& Pricing Strategy:** Analyze product mix and contribution margins to balance accessible consumer pricing with top\-tier gross profit margins.

**4\. Operational Leadership \& Store Launch ("Running the Show")**

* **Grand Opening \& Floor Execution:** Hire, onboard, and train the launch FOH and BOH teams, establishing a culture of high energy, hospitality, and strict operational execution.
* **SOP Creation:** Write and enforce operating manuals covering opening/closing checklists, supplement dosing accuracy, equipment calibration, hygiene, and inventory counts.
* **Brand Expansion:** Position Volta Cafe's flagship location for growth, designing playbooks for retail supplement sales, catering, pop\-ups, and future store openings.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Pre\-opening milestone execution (on\-time and on\-budget site launch).
* Initial COGS percentages achieved across functional energy drinks, matcha, coffee, and retail categories.
* Post\-launch EBITDA performance, net operating margins, and revenue growth.
* Sales velocity and adoption metrics of newly formulated energy drink recipes.
* Speed\-of\-service, guest review scores, and store team retention.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Proven Executive Leadership:** 5–8\+ years in senior beverage/hospitality operations (COO, Director of Operations, or High\-Volume GM) in New York City.
* **Pre\-Opening / Launch Experience:** Demonstrated track record of opening new restaurant or cafe concepts from zero to one (site buildout, vendor setup, initial team hiring, and DOHMH licensing).

**About World Business Lenders**

* World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate\-secured business loans for underserved businesses. WBL operates with a fully remote, multinational workforce and an experienced executive leadership team.
* Typically, the work schedule is from **9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday**, though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role* The Chief Operating Officer is responsible for providing operational leadership and coordination across the Company’s Lending Operations, including Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing, as well as Asset Resolution and Loan Administration (Servicing).
* This role will work closely with the senior leadership responsible for each function to ensure these areas operate as an integrated, end\-to\-end lending and asset lifecycle.
* The Chief Operating Officer will focus on improving coordination within and between departments, establishing consistent processes and performance standards, identifying operational bottlenecks, monitoring key performance indicators, and ensuring that issues are addressed before they negatively impact lending, servicing, or asset resolution.
* The Chief Operating Officer will focus on process integration, performance standards, operational efficiency, cross\-functional coordination, and resolution of issues across the broader lending and asset lifecycle.
* The position will report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and will serve as a key operational partner to executive leadership. The role will provide visibility into operational performance, risks, capacity, and opportunities for improvement across the functions within its scope.

 **What Success Looks Like**

* Improve coordination and accountability across Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration.
* Reduce operational bottlenecks and unnecessary handoffs.
* Improve turnaround times and overall process efficiency.
* Establish clear and measurable operational KPIs and improve visibility into performance for executive leadership.
* Identify and resolve recurring operational issues.
* Build scalable processes capable of supporting the company's continued growth.
* Create a unified and efficient end\-to\-end operating model across the lending, servicing, and asset\-resolution lifecycle.

* + Ensure the functions within Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration operate as an integrated process, with clear ownership and accountability for cross\-departmental workflows.
* + Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and communication breakdowns across the closing and asset lifecycle.
* + Develop and maintain standardized operating procedures, workflows, controls, service\-level expectations, and escalation processes.
* + Monitor operational performance and provide regular updates and recommendations to the CEO.

* **Closing Operations Oversight**
* + Work with Closing Operations leadership to monitor closing, funding, and related operational activities.
* + Identify recurring issues affecting Closing Operations or movement through the closing pipeline.
* + Coordinate with Valuations, Asset Resolution, Underwriting, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other relevant functions to improve execution.
* + Review operational reporting and identify trends requiring management attention.

* **Valuations Oversight**
* + Work with Valuations leadership to ensure valuation activities are properly integrated into closing and asset\-resolution processes.
* + Monitor valuation volume, turnaround times, quality, exceptions, and outstanding requests.
* + Identify delays that affect closing, underwriting, or asset resolution and establish appropriate prioritization and escalation processes.
* + Identify opportunities to improve valuation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

* **Asset Resolution Oversight**
* + Work with Asset Resolution leadership to ensure assets move efficiently through the resolution process.
* + Monitor resolution pipelines, aging, recoveries, dispositions, and other relevant operational metrics.
* + Identify operational issues affecting resolution outcomes and improve coordination with Closing Operations, Valuations, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* + Establish consistent processes for tracking assets through resolution and escalating matters requiring executive attention.
* + Identify opportunities to improve recovery outcomes, reduce cycle times, and increase operational efficiency.

* + Provide operational oversight across Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing.
* + Work with functional leaders to establish priorities, service levels, performance expectations, and escalation processes.
* + Identify bottlenecks, handoff issues, capacity constraints, and recurring problems across the lending pipeline.
* + Monitor operational reporting and KPIs across the lending lifecycle and recommend corrective actions.

* **Loan Administration (Servicing) Oversight**
* + Provide operational oversight of Loan Administration (Servicing) and its integration with the broader lending and asset lifecycle.
* + Monitor servicing workflows, performance, capacity, exceptions, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* + Identify opportunities to improve servicing efficiency, consistency, reporting, and coordination with Lending Operations and Asset Resolution.
* + Establish appropriate escalation and accountability proce

**HighRise Capital** is seeking a highly driven Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Sales \& Growth to take ownership of the company’s day\-to\-day operations, sales organization, employee performance, training, accountability, and growth.


The COO will act as the operational leader of the company and will be responsible for turning the CEO’s vision into daily execution.


This is a hands\-on leadership position.


We are looking for someone who wants to be on the sales floor, understands what is happening throughout the organization, knows the numbers, develops employees, holds people accountable, and continuously pushes the company toward higher production.


The COO will be responsible for building a disciplined, competitive, high\-performance culture where employees understand exactly what is expected of them every day.


Core Responsibilities


Run the Company Day\-to\-Day
Take ownership of the daily operation of the business.


The COO will:

* Run daily company operations.
* Ensure the office opens and operates effectively every morning.
* Make sure employees are on time, prepared, and working.
* Maintain structure and accountability throughout the sales floor.
* Coordinate sales, underwriting, processing, operations, and management.
* Identify operational problems before they become larger issues.
* Ensure management is executing company priorities.
* Create systems that allow the organization to scale.
* Report directly to the CEO on company performance.

The CEO should be able to set the direction of the company while trusting the COO to make sure that direction is executed every day.


Daily Morning Sales Meeting
The COO will personally lead a daily morning sales meeting.


The meeting should establish the tone and objectives for the day.


Topics should include:

* Previous day’s production
* Applications received
* Approvals
* Deals funded
* Funded volume
* Revenue generated
* Individual and team performance
* Current pipeline
* Daily targets
* Follow\-ups that need attention
* Wins and lessons from the previous day
* Sales strategy
* Motivation and accountability

Every employee should leave the meeting knowing exactly what they are expected to accomplish that day.


Sales Floor Leadership
The COO will maintain an active presence on the sales floor.


Responsibilities include:

* Monitoring employee activity.
* Ensuring representatives are consistently calling and following up.
* Identifying employees who need assistance or additional training.
* Reviewing sales conversations and performance.
* Helping managers improve underperforming representatives.
* Maintaining urgency throughout the day.
* Ensuring leads and opportunities are being worked properly.
* Preventing strong opportunities from being neglected.
* Creating healthy competition between individuals and teams.

This is not a position for someone who wants to manage entirely from an office.


The COO should understand what is happening on the floor throughout the day.


Training \& Development
Build a structured training program for new and existing employees.


Training should include:

* MCA and business\-financing fundamentals
* Product knowledge
* Prospecting
* Opening a sales conversation
* Merchant qualification
* Application generation
* Follow\-up
* Objection handling
* Closing
* Pipeline management
* CRM discipline
* Professional communication
* Compliance
* Sales psychology

The COO will also identify future managers and develop leadership internally.


Performance Management
Create clear expectations for every position.


Establish measurable KPIs for:

* Calls
* Conversations
* Applications
* Approvals
* Follow\-ups
* Conversion rates
* Funded deals
* Funded volume
* Revenue

Performance should be measured objectively.


The COO will conduct regular performance reviews and work with managers to develop employees who are below expectations.


When employees consistently fail to meet expectations despite coaching and appropriate opportunities to improve, the COO will be responsible for making necessary personnel decisions in coordination with company leadership.


Recruiting \& Team Growth
The COO will be responsible for helping **High Rise Capital** continuously improve and expand its team.


Responsibilities include:

* Establishing hiring targets.
* Working with recruiters.
* Interviewing senior and key sales hires.
* Building onboarding systems.
* Improving employee retention.
* Identifying future managers.
* Developing management layers as the company grows.
* Creating career paths for high\-performing employees.

The goal is not simply to add headcount.


The goal is to continuously increase productive headcount.


Company Growth
The COO will be accountable for helping grow the overall business.


This includes identifying ways to increase:

**Headcount**  **Applications**  **Approvals**  **Fundings**  **Funded Volume**  **Revenue**  **Profit**


The COO should constantly evaluate where the company is being constrained.


That may include:

* Recruiting
* Training
* Management
* Lead flow
* Sales performance
* Technology
* Underwriting
* Processing
* Lender relationships
* Operational efficiency

The COO will work with the CEO to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual growth targets and then build the operational plan necessary to reach them.


Management Structure

As an Area Manager in Business Banking, you'll lead a team of Business Relationship Managers (BRM) in developing new business and deepening existing relationships to position JPMorgan Chase as the primary bank for our clients.


**Job responsibilities**


* Provide leadership, management, support, direction, and guidance to a team of Business Relationship Managers within a territory in developing new deposit, cash management, and credit business while focusing on relationship\-building, client experience, and risk management
* Manage performance of individual team members, holding all Business Relationship Managers accountable for achieving business priorities with a focus on client experience and risk management
* Manage the area's revenue and profitability and monitor adherence to credit quality, regulatory requirements, and risk protocols; utilize reporting and metrics to monitor team performance, identify trends, and address or escalate issues in a timely manner
* Coach and develop team on all aspects of managing a portfolio, including relationship management, prospecting, profitability, client experience, and risk management; provide expertise to team on loan structuring, pricing, and developing customized solutions; help team identify solutions to complex challenges
* Hold Business Relationship Managers accountable for understanding the personal financial goals and needs of their business clients and connecting them with specialists who can help meet their financial needs
* Build collaborative relationships with partners across lines of business \- Chase Wealth Management, Home Lending, Branch Teams, Commercial Bank, and Private Bank \- to foster a One Chase, client\-centric environment and represent the bank in a community leadership capacity such as Chamber of Commerce and local non\-profit boards
* Actively recruit and maintain a pipeline of diverse viable candidates; select, hire, develop and retain top quality talent by creating an inclusive and respectful team environment

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Minimum of 7 years' experience in a Business Banking Relationship Management role or related business lending experience; direct in\-person contact required
* Expert knowledge of deposit and cash management products and services and expert knowledge of business credit underwriting with commercial credit training
* Strong communication skills with individuals at all levels, internally and externally
* Analyze reports, metrics, and other data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities
* Proven ability to build collaborative relationships across the organization and influence others to achieve desired outcomes, and the ability to lead proactively through change; Strong current business network; viewed as a leader in community organizations with demonstrated business acumen
* Balance needs of clients with associated risks and interests of the firm, and consistently use a disciplined process to manage time; use time strategically to balance long\-term and day\-to\-day demands of management role
* Travel occasionally for key business and leadership meetings and training

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**


* Bachelor's degree in Finance or related field or equivalent work experience
* Prior experience in managing a relationship development team

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES: The Director of Development serves as Parks \& People’s chief development officer with oversight of the development department. Specifically, the Director of Development is responsible for leading a development team in the strategy and execution of fundraising work that results in raising $3\.5M in annual operating income through major giving activities, grants from public and private sector funders, and individual giving appeals. Therefore, this role requires an experienced development professional who can provide the expertise to create dynamic annual plans to realize the needed revenue target, and personally participate in the work required to generate needed income.

MANAGEMENT \& OVERSIGHT:

 2\. Oversee the donor database system, grant tracking \& reporting systems, prospect research program, and a moves\-based portfolio management system.

 4\. Oversee creation of collateral material in support of fundraising endeavors.
